statement: Use browser-first as primary architecture; native Windows/Android work becomes optional later enhancement/fallback.
Store the KGP on dedicated branch knowledge/unruly-kgp and do not modify main/build branches during recovery.
Refresh KGP after each 2-4 checkpoint review batch.
Use two-finger single tap Undo and three-finger single tap Redo; earlier double-tap wording is superseded.
Drive sync must preserve both conflicting board revisions and let the user choose; no silent overwrite.
U2 was deliberately limited to Brush Library + Colour. Smudge, QuickShape, gesture expansion and U3/G02 functionality remain outside U2.
Windows distribution is a portable folder containing an executable and bundled dependencies; no installer. This supersedes the tentative single-HTML-file direction.
